meta.name: NASA/METI ASTER Global Digital Elevation Model (ASTER GDEM), ~30 m
meta.source: NASA LP DAAC / ASTER GDEM https://asterweb.jpl.nasa.gov/gdem.asp
meta.access: Open Topo Data public elevation API https://api.opentopodata.org/v1/aster30m
meta.dataset_note: 原计划使用 srtm30m (NASA/USGS SRTMGL1 v003)，采集时该端点持续读超时；改用同为 NASA 公开 ~30m 全球 DEM 的 ASTER GDEM。数据集列表见 https://www.opentopodata.org/
meta.api_limits: 100 locations/request, 1 request/second, 1000 requests/day; observed 40+ points/request times out, so 16 points/request used

controls.kind: ASTER GDEM measured elevation at sampled coordinates

render_grid.kind: bilinear interpolation + one 3x3 smoothing pass from controls; NOT a full-resolution DEM

meta.note: 现代开放 DEM 重建自然地形骨架；1948 年聚落、道路、水系与海岸线以军史史料为准。高程在数十年尺度上基本稳定，但城镇建成区、水库与海岸人工改变可能带来局部差异。
